source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check GPU Temperature via cmd: nvidia-smi --format=csv --query-gpu=temperature.gpu


1. All GPU Temperatures should be expected.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. All GPU Temperatures should be expected.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; correct read-only sensor query but lacks ambient, workload, threshold and sampling context.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / IMPROVED; adds UUID mapping, ambient/inlet and workload state, thermal policy, fan/power context and safety escalation.

original_test_intent: Measure every required GPU's temperature under a defined ambient and workload condition and verify the samples remain within the approved thermal limits without unresolved thermal events.
original_method: Run the source temperature query, bind each sample to UUID/Bus-Id and time, preserve ambient/inlet, workload, fan/power and thermal-event context, and apply the project sampling/threshold and Safety Stop policy.
manual_activity: Engineering defines environmental/workload conditions, limits and Safety Stop. Read-only sampling, correlation and threshold comparison are automated; this case does not authorize workload or cooling changes.
required_inputs: Ambient/inlet temperature and approved workload state
Warning, critical and Safety Stop limits by GPU/platform
Fan/power context sources and driver/nvidia-smi version
safety_requirements: Use read-only nvidia-smi; do not change fans, clocks, power limits or workload.
Apply the approved thermal Safety Stop immediately if an execution plan includes continued sampling under load.
Preserve high, N/A, missing and error readings with timestamps and ambient/workload context.
Do not automatically retry, extend the run or reset a GPU after a threshold breach.
agent_execution_scope: Collect stable GPU identity, tool version, ambient/inlet and workload/fan/power context.
Execute the exact source query at the approved cadence with raw output/return codes.
Compare each GPU's samples and events to the approved limits and report Tool Result/stop condition.
engineer_actions: Provide/approve thermal/sampling/Safety Stop policy and operating conditions.
Investigate cooling, sensor or workload anomalies.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field is appropriate for GPU temperature, but one sample without identity/environment/workload context cannot establish `expected` thermal behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain temperature.gpu and add only approved timestamped sampling plus fan/power/ambient context; do not manipulate cooling to obtain a value.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The temperature field and both 1-minute fields are preserved; any longer project sampling must be reported as an override.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture per-UUID temperature time series with inlet/ambient, power, fan, workload and thermal-event context under explicit stop thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: NVIDIA GPUs exposing temperature through the installed driver/NVML.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record driver, nvidia-smi/NVML, GPU firmware, BIOS/BMC, fan-control policy, OS and workload versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA System Management Interface documentation for the deployed driver and project platform thermal specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds environment, timing and safety semantics without replacing the sensor field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every GPU remains sampled.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Platform thermal and Safety Stop policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A GPU sensor reading does not alone prove inlet conditions or cooling-path health; correlated evidence is required.

project_override_considerations: A project may set idle/load condition, thresholds, cadence and duration. The report must state actual environment and cannot generalize a one-minute idle sample to loaded thermal coverage.
expected_evidence: Tool/driver version and complete GPU identity map
Ambient/inlet, workload, fan/power and approved thermal/stop policy
Raw timestamped temperature samples and exit codes
Per-GPU threshold/event comparison including outliers and stop record
Final thermal/driver/BMC health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently asks for expected GPU temperatures; the missing environmental thresholds are readiness inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only collection is safe; missing thermal policy affects final interpretation and continued-run safety, not static review or permanent capability.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the exact sensor field but corrects the context-free single-reading weakness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with FULLY AUTOMATABLE and retains ambient/workload, fan/power, policy and Safety Stop requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly separates harmless collection from any unapproved load/cooling action and preserves formal verdict ownership.

review_improvement: Turns an isolated temperature number into traceable thermal evidence without expanding the case into autonomous stress or cooling control.
independent_technical_reasoning: Sensor collection and policy comparison are machine-executable; environmental parameters and verdict remain engineer inputs. This satisfies FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat/extend sampling, start stress, change cooling or reset hardware automatically after an abnormal temperature or query failure.
